messages:
maria: Quick sync  were finalizing SEO ops for the launch posts + webinar. Priorities: benchmark narrative visibility, webinar signups, hreflang for en-US/en-GB, clean redirects, and SFDC lead routing. Who owns what?

sam: Ill take keyword clusters and meta titles. plan: two pillar clusters (benchmarking inference, cost tooling) + demo intent cluster. will tag DEMO rows.

jake: Ill own JSON-LD and schema checks. will add Event, FAQPage, and Organization snippets and a Next.js include. small note: include organizer and startDate for Event markup.

olivia: Ill do internal linking, sitemap updates, and the redirect diff. rule: retired post -> 301 to pillar; homepage fallback only if no match. will detect chains and collisions.

kevin-salesops: For SFDC: use campaign=WEB-LAUNCH-3410, include hidden form field campaign in every landing form. Ill validate after staging.

eng-release: Deploy window Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC for redirects. Olivia need CSV + revert list 12h prior.

seo-ci-bot: CI queued: redirect-diff + schema-validate. Upload redirect CSV to /marketing/seo/redirects/launch-3410001111.csv and schema partial to /marketing/seo/schema/ to trigger.

sam: Uploaded seed KW: https://drive.redwood/seo/kw-seed-3410001111.csv  includes locales, intent tags, meta title suggestions, and CTA mapping.

jake: Sample JSON-LD for webinar: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Benchmark Workshop","startDate":"2026-08-12T17:00:00Z","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}} (will push as include).

olivia: Redirect sweep plan (short): 1) export current redirects, 2) diff with proposed CSV, 3) flag collisions & chains, 4) create revert list, 5) update sitemap and submit index. smoke test: `curl -I -L https://redwood.ai/old-path` -> expect 200 final.

maria: Hreflang: add en-US and en-GB on pillar+landing. Sam note locales in sheet. Also we want Search Console + GA4 checks post-launch.

sam: will add locale-specific title variants and mark target page locales in the sheet.

jake: QA checklist: JSON-LD passes Rich Results test, hreflang tags correct, canonical headers present, no duplicate meta descriptions across pillars. will add automated schema lint in docs CI.

olivia: Will post redirect CSV to shared drive and run CI. then run staging smoke and paste curl logs here.

kevin-salesops: Ill confirm SFDC mapping after forms wired and report back on campaign counts.

maria: Preflight short list: KW sheet locked, schema validated, internal links + hreflang applied, redirect CSV tested, SFDC tracking wired. Mark done in the sheet.

seo-ci-bot: Preflight status: 1/6 (KW sheet present). Waiting: schema include, redirect CSV, internal-link diff, hreflang verification, SFDC wiring.

maria: Thanks team  keep updates here and ping #eng-release when staging passes.
